identityResolution.note: Task 13 re-attach (2026-09-08): the original upload's two extra files were lost to a sandbox reset. Web verification showed BOTH of their labels were mislabels — rebuilt from fresh mirror fetches under the TRUE lawIds (never guessed, per manifest.schema.json):
identityResolution.civilTransactions25_1980: No Kuwaiti law '25/1980' exists (web search returned nothing). Kuwait's Civil Code is المرسوم بالقانون رقم 67 لسنة 1980 بإصدار القانون المدني — rebuilt as KW_CivilCode_67_1980_clean.json under lawId 67/1980.
identityResolution.rental51_1996: Kuwait Law 51/1996 is the Personal Status Law (الأحوال الشخصية) — the LKB already holds 14 fixture summary rows under 51/1996. The rental law is المرسوم بالقانون رقم 35 لسنة 1978 في شأن إيجار العقارات — rebuilt as KW_Rental_35_1978_clean.json under lawId 35/1978.
identityResolution.provenance: Raw mirror snapshots pinned at corpus/_raw/ (almohami.com law library, fetched 2026-09-08). Mirror-class: attestation=false on the derived inbox drops, lawyer pins the real gazette identity in Phase 0.

lawIdMapping.note: Mirror files use their own law_id namespace; the repo convention (rules/catalog.ts + seed fixtures) is '<number>/<year>'. Ingest rewrites lawId accordingly so resolveRef and engine rule refs keep matching.

knownQuirks: 171 articles embed amendment provenance inline: 'النص النهائي للمادة ...' + 'النص الأصلي للمادة:' — ingest splits these into a version chain (v1 original, v2 amended) mirroring the kb/audit amend mechanism

Some labels carry a repeal marker ('ملغاة') whose subject is ambiguous (article vs amending law) — ingest keeps the original text ACTIVE + unverified and surfaces the marker in verification_note; the lawyer decides in Phase 0
